meta_description: Plumbing 360 Guildford — emergency plumbing, repairs, installations and maintenance. Same-day callouts across Surrey. Call now for rapid response.
hero_eyebrow: Same-Day Emergency Callouts — Local Guildford Plumber
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or boiler breakdown? We arrive in under 60 minutes, 7 days a week.
services_subhead: From emergency burst pipes to full bathroom installations, we handle every plumbing job with speed and skill.

services.title: Emergency Burst Pipes & Leaks
services.desc: Burst pipe at 2am? We're on our way. Rapid diagnosis, containment, and repair to stop water damage before it spreads through your home.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Installation
services.desc: Boiler won't fire up or making strange noises? We diagnose faults fast and repair or install modern, efficient systems that cut your heating bills.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Plumbing
services.desc: Installing a new suite or upgrading taps and pipework? We manage all pipework, water pressure, and drainage to keep everything working smoothly.

services.title: Central Heating Systems
services.desc: Power flushing, radiator balancing, pump replacement, and full system installation. Keep your heating efficient and your home warm through winter.

services.title: Blocked Drains & Unblocking
services.desc: Slow drains or sewage backups? We use drain rods and CCTV inspection to find the blockage and clear it without damaging your pipes.

services.title: General Plumbing Maintenance
services.desc: Routine inspections, joint repairs, stopcock testing, and preventative work. Regular maintenance stops small issues becoming expensive emergencies.

about_pullquote: I started Plumbing 360 because homeowners deserve honest, fast plumbing without the wait or the overcharge.
about_para_1: Plumbing 360 was founded over a decade ago with one clear aim: to be the plumber Guildford residents actually want to call. We've built a reputation on turning up on time, diagnosing problems straight, and fixing them right first time. Our team knows every street in Guildford and the surrounding Surrey villages.
about_para_2: We're not a call centre routing you to a van three towns over — you speak to a local plumber who understands your home and your area. Hundreds of Guildford families have trusted us with their emergencies, and we've never let them down. That's why most of our work comes from repeat customers and their recommendations.
reviews_heading: What Guildford Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe in the kitchen just before we went away for Christmas. Phoned Plumbing 360 thinking we'd never get anyone, and they were here within 45 minutes. Fixed it properly, not just a quick bodge. Fair price too. Wouldn't use anyone else now.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Boiler had been playing up for weeks. Got a same-day appointment, and the engineer explained exactly what was wrong without trying to sell me a new one. Repaired the pump and it's been perfect ever since. Really professional and friendly bloke.
reviews.author: Patricia L.

reviews.text: Called them at 10pm because our heating stopped working. They were round by 11 and got us back up and running before midnight. Couldn't believe the response time. Saved us a freezing night. Genuinely grateful.
reviews.author: David H.
